english_description: A calendar month stored as an unsigned byte with the supported Gregorian month range.

queries.english: Whether the stored month is within the supported calendar range.

constraints.english: ok() is true exactly when the stored month is between 1 and 12 inclusive.

adversary_table.scenario: The unsigned-byte value zero is passed to ok().
adversary_table.resolution: Return false because zero is outside the month range.

adversary_table.scenario: The unsigned-byte value thirteen is passed to ok().
adversary_table.resolution: Return false because thirteen is outside the month range.

source_references.notes: Pinned C++ month representation and ok() range check, supported by accepted E-12.
